list:
A mahogany frame with a high-quality animal skin spread across it. Sound the drums, usher peace into Yumen.
The young apprentice who had just started training kung fu with the boss for a few months hears the pounding of the three drums, feels the heat of his blood, and throws a set of respectable punches.

An antique-style floor lamp with a rice paper shade treated with an herbal balm to ward off biting insects.
A prestigious figure who once came to see the doctor here dipped his hand in wine and wrote something on the lampshade. People often mistake it for some high-level fung fu, but when they go sneak a peek, they only see a few blurry words: 'Do it yourself.'

The seat is too deep to be suitable for reclining, but is perfect for drawing your legs back and curling up.
For maladies that cannot be cured with herbs, acupuncture, or cupping, the clinic's owner will teach patients a set of exercises such as meditation or qigong, which may dispel blood stasis and relieve knotting of the heart.

A wall of real wood, decorated with the interplay of square and circle that reflects the adage that talent must not transcend righteousness, and that mindfulness ought to encompass all things.
Herbalism is much like kung fu, in that herbs and trees are just like punches and kicks– each has their own identifiable rules, and only after understanding them can one move forward.

Though they are but crude stone tiles, they have been stationed in the city of Yumen for hundreds of years.
Twenty years ago, upon them approached the sound of armor scraping against stone. The clinic's lights shone a long vigil, and the doctor brewed strong tea, waiting for warriors to return from the disaster seeking medical treatment.

The observation deck's walls are carved from the finest mahogany, with a dead branch brought back from the desert planted within the pot.
Perhaps because children often pour their bitter herbal soups into the pot, fresh shoots will occasionally emerge from these dry branches.

A solid wooden pillar supporting the beams of the roof. The room's interior has been renovated many times, and only it remains constant.
It has survived the shaking of the mountains and the splitting of the earth, it has blocked knives and swords. Even if it is now only used to hang clothes, it still props up a corner of Yumen in its own way.

The wooden laundry tubs commonly used by the people of Yumen often have a fine mesh at the bottom to filter out the sand mixed in with their clothes.
Since the boss secretly sprinkled ground shan yao into the medicine cabinet, the apprentice no longer dares to wash clothes with saponin powder.
Rope knots are woven in the winter, for the spring of the coming year must closely follow.
theme: A clinic, reconstructed based on Waai Fu's descriptions. A place like this, where martial instruments outnumber medical ones, would only be found in Yumen.

list:
You have completed your journey in Yumen.
The wounded city comes to a temporary stop, as travelers set off on their journeys once more, with their newfound answers. It is not yet too late.
During the 'Where Vernal Winds Will Never Blow' event, obtain Operator Jieyun.

You come across an Anasa girl with pure eyes.
She does not understand her master's 'ideals,' but is willing to travel afar for them. Thus, a rock in the wilderness finds itself tumbling into a nomadic city.
New Customer At Old Workshop Medal
During the 'Where Vernal Winds Will Never Blow' event, consume 2400 Newly-Distilled Liedaozi in [Sword Forge].

You witnessed the Sword Forge's craftsmen forge weapons and collected a great number of fine treasures.
Though old friends have departed, new blades must yet be forged, for the jianghu yet remains.
Complete all stages in [Case Investigation, Onsite] with 3-star ratings (excluding tutorials).

You have successfully locked down the Shanhaizhong that infiltrated the city.
Those who have grown used to the poplars are familiar with every breeze and every grain of sand.
Complete all the content in [Yumen Arena Board of Fame] and collect the rewards.

You have made a name for yourself on the long-standing Yumen Arena Board of Fame.
Having your name on the board is like having wine when you are happy; it is merely a compliment to your joy. Every man has a responsibility to defend their homeland.
Clear WB-9 with a 3-star rating and defeat 'Ya' while Delusion is active.

You have exposed Its background and uncovered Its purpose.
Anger, bewilderment, humiliation... countless subtle emotions fade away in fleeting moments, yet they exist in this ceaseless, eternal moment.
Clear WB-EX-1 with a 3-star rating with at least 3 'Roadblocks' remaining on the battlefield.

Your contributions to the Patrol Battalion's deployment have been immense, filling all around you with admiration.
There is traditional saying in the Yumen army: 'There are a wealth of young men practicing kung fu in Yumen, and they are not as tall as the wooden stake when they first start practicing.'
Complete all stages in [Criminal Pursuit, Offsite] on Challenge Mode.

You have finished reading Heroes of Yumen and have discovered the true chaos both within and outside of the story. Turbulent winds and clouds grow old as those who come continue to pursue. Keeping my difficulties quiet, my heart remains steadfast.
Clear WB-EX-3 with a 3-star rating with no more than 1 Shanhaizhong Cipher Machine remaining on the battlefield.

Your performance before the Yumen army has greatly roused all those in attendance.
Hear the winds beating the drums, the rattling of the sheathes, and the songs of triumph.
Clear WB-EX-4 with a 3-star rating with no more than 2 Shanhaizhong Harbingers having climbed onto the Yumen Catastrophe Defenses.

You recorded the poem the poet composed in the face of Catastrophe.
'All of Heaven and earth in a flask. That long dream, tragic ere and now.'
set: Where Vernal Winds Will Never Blow Engraved Medal Set

An engraved medal set that chronicles the entirety of the Yumen soldiers and civilians' confrontation with the Catastrophe.
Though the borderlands are rarely trodden, there must still be loyal men who would stand up against the rolling sands.
Life should be full of satisfaction, and generations should reach the pinnacle together.
